parsed.rationale: All 15 participating records are unnamed extensions (name: "") on `View` spread across unrelated packages — WXUI, Wallpaper, PartyHorn, PlayerHeaderView, MusicShareKit, and app:iOS. The structural signal is a name-collision query that has surfaced the fact that every SwiftUI file in the codebase can declare an `extension View { … }` block; this is idiomatic Swift/SwiftUI practice, not a duplication problem. The extensions live in semantically unrelated files (`GlassEffect+Compatibility.swift`, `PlaybackBlendMode.swift`, `WipeDownRevealModifier.swift`, `StatusBarStyleModifier.swift`, etc.) and carry no shared `fields_or_signature` entries (`shared_field_count: null`, `jaccard: null`), so there is no evidence of duplicated members to consolidate. Consolidating these across package boundaries would couple unrelated UI concerns and violate package encapsulation.
